newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads - Outshine most of the bloc.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads - Outshine most of the bloc.

text.p: The Australian bond market generally outperformed the dollar bloc on its return from Monday's holiday, holding most of the U.S.-led rally made in after-hours trading on Friday.

The most notably margin tightening was against New Zealand which came under pressure in the face of a weak N.Z. TWI and as the market kept a nervous eye out for any comment by the RBNZ on whether it is happy with current monetary conditions.
The local market again narrowed to the U.S. on the expectation that the RBA is still on an easing bias with the Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread nearing key resistance at 65 basis points.
Thoughts of a cut in the current 5.5 percent official interest rate may gather further momentum if this Thursday's labour force data for May proves weak, traders said.
